> 第5章 丹馆（第1页）
“那不是陆沉吗？他不是被城主废了吗？还跑来丹馆做什么？”
“也许，他想找丹药恢复修为吧。”
“扯淡，丹田废了，武脉毁了，大罗金丹也救不了他。”
“嘿嘿，丹馆和城主府的关系不菲，他得罪了城主，丹馆会让他进去就有鬼了。”
幸灾乐祸的人多的是，他都懒得理会了。
丹馆的守卫拦住陆沉，毫不客气的喝道，“凡人和废人，不得入内！”
丹馆是有一条规定，非武者不得入内。
什么时侯，又多了一条废人不得入内？
迟早要你身败名裂，死无葬身之地。
当务之急，是买到醒龙草，而不是跟一条看门狗计较。
陆沉压下怒火，也不跟废话，直接释放气息。
“假象而已，谁知道你的修为是真是假？”
守卫回过神来，哼了一声，就是不放陆沉进去。
“既然有修为，就应该放人家进去。”
“什么时侯，一个守卫就可以改变丹馆的规定了？”
“我看啊，丹馆馆主让守卫来当就行了。”
的确，一开始，这些人就是想看陆沉热闹的。
但陆沉暴露修为，有些人的想法又不一样了。

哪怕只有炼体境五重，在双木城也是中等水平的存在。
这些人之中，大多数的境界还是炼体境五重以下呢。
但守卫领了上面的指示，坚决不退让。
“少废话，你不滚是吧，老子扔你出去。”
守卫老羞成怒，徒然张开五指，抓向陆沉。
这一抓，力重三千斤，被抓中绝对皮开肉绽。
守卫是炼体境六重，陆沉才炼体境五重，怎么抵挡？
守卫反被陆沉抓住了手腕，疼得大汗淋漓，正忙不迭的求饶：“陆……陆少主，小的知错了，丹馆你随便进吧，只求求你，千万别折断小人的手啊。”
陆沉哼了一声，手一甩，直接把守卫扔出数丈之外。
此时，陆沉气息澎湃，气势如虹，犹如利剑出鞘。
连守卫都不是陆沉一合之敌，谁还敢说一句对陆沉不恭的话？
当发现了陆沉的实力，就没人讥笑了。
陆沉走进来，丹馆所有工作人员均感到惊讶。
陆沉没有理会这些，直接向一个工作人员开口，要买醒龙草。

Lu Chen's latest chapter_Chapter 5 Alchemy Hall Page 1_Lu Chen Mo Feng Lie_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 5 Dan Pavilion (Page 1)
"Isn't that Lu Chen? Wasn't he deposed by the city lord? Why did he come to the alchemy hall?"
"Perhaps he wants to find elixirs to restore his cultivation."
"It's nonsense. His dantian is useless, his martial arteries are ruined, and even Daluo Jindan can't save him."
"Hehe, the Alchemy Hall has a close relationship with the City Lord's Mansion. If he offended the City Lord, there will be trouble in the Alchemy Hall if he lets him in."
There were so many people gloating about his misfortune that he didn't even bother to pay attention.
The guard of the alchemy hall stopped Lu Chen and shouted unceremoniously, "Mortals and disabled people are not allowed to enter!"
There is a rule in the alchemy hall that non-martialists are not allowed to enter.
When will there be another barrier for disabled people to enter?
Sooner or later, your reputation will be ruined and you will die without a burial place.
The top priority is to buy Dragon Awakening Grass instead of worrying about a watchdog.
Lu Chen suppressed his anger, didn't talk nonsense, and just released his breath.
"It's just an illusion. Who knows whether your cultivation is real or fake?"
The guard came to his senses, snorted, but refused to let Lu Chen in.
"Since you have cultivation, you should let people in."
"When will a guard be able to change the rules of the alchemy hall?"
"I see, the owner of the alchemy hall can just ask the guards to be the guards."
Indeed, from the beginning, these people just wanted to see Lu Chen lively.
But when Lu Chen exposed his cultivation, some people thought differently.
Even if he is only at the fifth level of the Body Refining Realm, he is still at an average level in Shuangmu City.
Among these people, most of them are still below the fifth level of the Body Refining Realm.
But the guards received the instructions from above and refused to give in.
"Stop talking nonsense. If you don't get out, I'll throw you out."
The guard became angry from shame and stretched his fingers in vain to grab Lu Chen.
The force of this grab was three thousand kilograms, and the skin and flesh were absolutely torn when caught.
The guard is at the sixth level of the Body Refining Realm, and Lu Chen is at the fifth level of the Body Refining Realm. How can he resist?
Instead, the guard's wrist was grabbed by Lu Chen. He was sweating profusely in pain and was begging for mercy: "Lu... Young Master Lu, I understand my mistake. You can enter the alchemy hall as you like. I beg you, please don't break this villain's hand."
Lu Chen snorted, flicked his hand, and threw the guard several feet away.
At this time, Lu Chen's aura was surging, his momentum was like a rainbow, like a sharp sword unsheathed.
Even the guards are not Lu Chen's enemies, who dares to say a disrespectful word to Lu Chen?
When they discovered Lu Chen's strength, no one laughed at him.
When Lu Chen walked in, all the staff in the alchemy hall were surprised.
Lu Chen ignored these and directly asked a staff member to buy the Dragon Awakening Grass.
